notes.content:

[b]AVICII Invector[/b]

notes.title: Introducing The Wired Summer Of Indie Gaming
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33134072/c8e9a2f9109b3264375a1b3ebae3bdccd1b2c407.jpg[/img]

We all know that June is where the hottest gaming action happens with conventions, E3 (or this year technically 'NotE3') announcements, launches and SO MANY SALES! This year Wired are ensuring that the indie scene parties just as hard with the announcement of the Wired #SummerOfIndieGaming!

A month long celebration of brand new trailers, competitions, sales, a game launch and a couple of announcements along the way! We aren't cruel enough to just tease you like that though, so let's get a quick run down of everything included in the #SummerOfIndieGaming, what we've already done, and what you can look forward to!

Wired’s Summer of Indie Gaming Schedule Includes: 

[b]3rd - 10th June - Steam Publisher Sale (This has been and gone, we hope you picked up something nice!)[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33134072/f4cc3888311c8550c19a68326c98750bdedd49be.jpg[/img]


[b]- 8th June - OTK Festival [[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1299690/Gori_Cuddly_Carnage/]Gori: Cuddy Carnage][/url][/b]

Tin Hearts marched onto the Upload VR showcase!

[b]

[previewyoutube=iWcm2KiOfp8;full][/previewyoutube]


[previewyoutube=xfQi6eVv7tc;full][/previewyoutube]

Keep your eyes peeled to #WiredLive for that very soon!

notes.title: Avicii Invector: Encore Edition Is Now Out On Meta Quest 2!
notes.content:
Prepare to explore the rhythmic regions of unexplored space in a completely new way! AVICII Invector: Encore Edition is now available on Meta Quest 2!

Watch our brand new launch trailer showing the incredible journey taken by the game that Tim started, and how Quest 2 brings you AVICII's greatest hits in a new dimension!

[previewyoutube=wbUBOOvX1mo;full][/previewyoutube]


In loving memory of Swedish DJ Tim Bergling, most famously known by his professional name, AVICII, Hello There Games and Tim’s father, Klas Bergling, continue Tim’s vision of bringing new ways to experience his music, with AVICII Invector: Encore Edition.

Featuring 35 chart topping tracks such as Peace of Mind, Freak and S.O.S, AVICII Invector brings the futuristic rhythm action gameplay into a VR version for Meta Quest 2 which is available to purchase right now!

[h2]AVICII Invector: Encore Edition Features:[/h2]

⦁ 35 hit anthems from the phenomenal talent of late superstar AVICII.
⦁ SEVEN mesmerising worlds wrapped in a magnificent musical experience viewable in VR.
⦁ Turn up the volume and set yourself a challenge across FOUR complexity levels.
⦁ Lay down your high score and rise up the Global Leaderboards.
⦁ Explore a pure-hearted narrative journey set against the globally celebrated works of AVICII.

As with our releases on other platforms , all music royalties from each copy of the game sold will go to the Tim Bergling Foundation, which advocates for the recognition of suicide as a global health emergency and actively works to remove the stigma attached to suicide and mental health issues.

We'd like to take this moment to thank all of the AVICII fans for their support with Invector from the very beginning, it's a very personal project for us! And whilst we don't know where the journey for Invector ends, we're proud to have had you with us every step of the way!

You can find out more about the Tim Bergling Foundation by visiting: [url=https://www.timberglingfoundation.org/]https://www.timberglingfoundation.org/[/url]

And buy Avicii Invector On Meta Quest 2 by visiting: [url=https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4048766301899067/]https://www.oculus.com/experiences/quest/4048766301899067/[/url]

notes.title: The input update
notes.content:
A new update is available!

We have added controller remapping, controller specific settings and a new Input calibration screen.
We have also reset the leaderboards so let the climbing begin!

ːaviciiː ːaviciiː ːaviciiː

Change log
[list]
[*] Controller remapping
[*] New input calibration, (No visual cues, you should just listen and tap)
[*] Input related settings are saved per device so you can have different settings among players when playing multiplayer. (there is always one person wants to invert the y axis :wink:
[*] Various bug fixes
[*] Timing windows adjusted to be more forgiving to compensate for inaccurate input timing on some systems
[/list]

notes.content:
Hello everyone! We hope that you are well and staying safe. We have a new patch coming for Steam with some hotfixes and the ability to remap controllers. At the same time, we will reset high scores as it has become bloated with incorrect entries. On a side note, how often would you like to see the high score reset? Please express your opinion through this poll
http://directpoll.com/v?XDVhEtvC48KFoQpDqcJs5ToFuMAdMZ

notes.title: Avicii Invector Encore Edition content comes to Steam
notes.content:
Today as the EDM world celebrates Avicii's birthday - we are proud to join the celebration of Tim's life and lasting musical legacy by releasing two new DLC packs for Avicii Invector!

The Encore Edition was released to the world on the back of the Nintendo Switch release showcased in our new trailer - visible here!

[previewyoutube=tRcbgfXAZms;full][/previewyoutube]

Encore Edition comes with a new world to soar through, as well as  10 new tracks on top of the original 25 songs!
The additional 10 songs are also available on all other platforms in the form of two DLC packs containing 5 new songs each.

The 'Tim Pack' contains :

[list]
[*] Bad Reputation
[*] Freak
[*] Heart upon my sleeve
[*] Peace of mind
[*] SOS
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356410/AVICII_Invector__TIM_Track_Pack/

Whilst the Magma pack contains : 

[list]
[*] Addicted to you
[*] My Feelings For You
[*] Seek Bromance
[*] Sunshine
[*] Trouble
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1356411/AVICII_Invector__Magma_Track_Pack/

Each song pack is available for £4.99 - and is obtainable through the Steam store right now!

From everyone at Hello There Games, and Wired Productions - thank you for sharing our passion and love for Avicii Invector so far. We are consummate music fans and aim to make an impact with our efforts.  All of AVICII Music’s net proceeds will go directly to the Tim Bergling Foundation, which advocates for the recognition of suicide as a global health emergency and promotes removing the stigma attached to the discussion of mental health issues

notes.title: The smooth update
notes.content:
We have worked hard to make Avicii Invector a faster, smoother and better experience.

Changes and bug fixes: 
[list]
[*] Fixed many of the crash bugs.
[*] Refactored the input system to fix the button prompts. Now correct buttons are displayed for your controller type.
[*] Massive optimizations, making the game run better and have shorter loading pauses.
[*] Smoother menu flow.
[*] Added Turkish localization
[/list]

Please let us know in the steam forums if there's any issues found in this update, its a major one in many ways.

More news coming soon from us at Hello There and Wired Productions!
